cases.text: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks.
How do I activate the card you sent me?
Can I get a virtual card for online shopping?
My transfer to my landlord is still pending since Monday.
I sent money to the wrong account, can you reverse it?
How long does a bank transfer from abroad take?
My top up didn't go through but the money left my account.
Can I top up my account with a cheque?
Why was my top-up reverted?
The ATM gave me less cash than I asked for.
The cash machine kept my card.
Where can I withdraw cash for free?
Why was I charged a fee for withdrawing cash?
What exchange rate do you use when I pay in euros?
There is an extra charge on my statement for a transfer.
A card payment I made yesterday shows up twice.
I'd like a refund for an item I returned to the shop.
My payment was declined at the supermarket.
Someone used my card without my permission.
I lost my phone and my card, please freeze everything.
There's a transaction I don't recognise, I think my card was stolen.
How do I verify my identity?
I want to change my PIN.
Please close my account.

note: Hand-written messages, three per queue, labelled by the routing rules in shared/queues.py (a PIN change is card_services; any fee question, even about cash, is fees_fx). queue/confidence are the deployed checkpoint's outputs when this fixture was written.
